mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above the 2017 base (100) indicates ongoing economic expansion, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1300) indicates robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: The CPIAUCSL index, being an inflation measure with a base of 100 (1982-1984), is always above 100, and a higher index value (indicating higher inflation) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 100 (which is always), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1400 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous high inflation reading (CPIAUCSL > 315) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 2017 base (100) signals an economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
